name: focus-tidbyt
title: Focus Tidbyt
description: Sync Raycast Focus timers to a Tidbyt/Tronbyt display.
author: lukas-69

commands.name: start-focus-tidbyt
commands.title: Start Focus + Tidbyt
commands.description: Start a Raycast Focus session and push updates to Tidbyt

commands.name: stop-focus-tidbyt
commands.title: Stop Focus + Tidbyt
commands.description: Stop the Raycast Focus session and clear Tidbyt

commands.name: refresh-tidbyt
commands.title: Refresh Tidbyt
commands.description: Background refresh to update the Tidbyt countdown

commands.name: preview-tidbyt-frame
commands.title: Preview Tidbyt Frame
commands.description: Render a local preview image for the countdown

commands.name: test-push-tidbyt
commands.title: Test Push Tidbyt
commands.description: Push a test image using the selected provider

preferences.name: pushProvider
preferences.title: Push Provider
preferences.description: Choose whether to push to Tidbyt (official cloud) or Tronbyt (self-hosted).

preferences.name: tidbytDeviceId
preferences.title: Tidbyt Device ID
preferences.description: From the Tidbyt mobile app, open Settings → Get API key and copy the Device ID.

preferences.name: tidbytApiToken
preferences.title: Tidbyt API Key
preferences.description: API key generated in the Tidbyt mobile app (Settings → Get API key).

preferences.name: tidbytPixletPath
preferences.title: Pixlet Path (Optional)
preferences.description: Path to the pixlet binary used for Tidbyt pushes (default: pixlet).

preferences.name: tronbytBaseUrl
preferences.title: Tronbyt Base URL
preferences.description: Use the URL where the Tronbyt Server web app is reachable (default: http://localhost:8000). Only required for pushing updates.

preferences.name: tronbytDeviceId
preferences.title: Tronbyt Device ID
preferences.description: In the Tronbyt Server web app, open the Devices list and copy the ID shown for your device. Only required for pushing updates.

preferences.name: tronbytApiToken
preferences.title: Tronbyt API Token
preferences.description: Token used to authenticate with the Tronbyt API

preferences.name: tronbytAuthHeader
preferences.title: Authorization Header (Optional)
preferences.description: Overrides token-based auth if set. Example: Bearer abc123

preferences.name: installationId
preferences.title: Installation ID
preferences.description: Used to overwrite the same app slot on the device

preferences.name: updateInterval
preferences.title: Update Interval
preferences.description: How often to push updates (e.g. 10s, 30s, 1m). Background runs every 10 seconds.

preferences.name: startShortcutName
preferences.title: Start Shortcut Name
preferences.description: Apple Shortcut that starts a Raycast Focus session

preferences.name: completeShortcutName
preferences.title: Complete Shortcut Name
preferences.description: Apple Shortcut that completes a Raycast Focus session
